source.prompt: Create a landing page for Oleander's, a Portuguese restaurant at 22 Regent Street, Clifton, Bristol BS8 4HG. Named staff: Ana Ferreira (chef-owner), Marcus Webb (sous chef), Tom Ferreira (front of house). Full menu with prices: clams £13.50, bread £4.50, bacalhau £22, pork shoulder £24, lamb chops £27, custard tart £5. Set lunch £19/£24. Opening hours: Tue dinner only, Wed–Fri lunch + dinner, Sat dinner only, closed Sun–Mon. All copy specific to Portuguese Alentejo cuisine, Bristol area suppliers (Hart's Bakery, Pipers Farm).

notes: Specific city (Bristol/Clifton), named chef-owner with backstory (Évora, Alentejo), real supplier names (Hart's Bakery, Pipers Farm), itemised menu with prices, concrete opening hours, private hire pricing.
